summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0, authored and generated Levels 1–4, and M.E.G. Base Gamma. Ordered player and NPC behavior chains pair movement/combat with shared helpers; place simulations build local spaces and actors, and Level 4 now layers resident lives, office activities, destructible interiors and networked Back OS terminals over its office plan.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's generated yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded moments and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, camp agents, searchable loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze zones/crawl halls, lamps, Gamma fortress checkpoint, hazards, loot and creature brigades; blackouts and powered lift lead to Level 4.

places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards and residents; objects.scene carries named agents' skin-attached heads, and sim adds the locked Database computer.

places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office, a 64×64 m floor with perimeter/corner offices, fountains, break-room vending, Level 3 lift, chained stairs and Base Omega; sim adds residents, cubicles, phones, printers, shift board, computers and breakable walls/props.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, actions, player template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry and presented yaw/pitch with crouched eye height.
places/<place>/sim.js - local setup/tick roots; Level 4 builds the office and resident routines, and checks windows and breakables; Gamma places its database terminal.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 4 config supplies office atmosphere/look and x0z0 carries its layered set.
scripts/ui.js with loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js, craft-ui.js, os-ui.js, horde-ui.js and noclip-ui.js - HUD composition and action routing.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading behavior; player template and M.E.G. NPC behavior chains use it before movement controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim and creatures.
scripts/lib/level4.js - office room/wall plan, zones, sanity rates and names read by Level 4 geometry, resident/office systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + scripts/lib/data/level4-people.yml - Level 4 residents' homes, daily rounds, meetups, greetings and phone errands; place sim spawns the shared NPC agents.
scripts/lib/os.js + scripts/lib/data/os.yml - shared Back OS profiles, mail/files/Database/forum and terminal commands consumed by os.js and os-ui.js on office, Omega and Gamma hosts.

scripts/lib/level0-moments.js + scripts/moments-geo.js + scripts/moments.js - deterministic Level 0 oddity placement/behavior; scripts/lib/furniture.js + furniture-loot.yml - searchable container placement/loot shared by Levels 0, 1 and 3 (Level 2 has its own path).
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js, weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js and weapon-geo.js - weapon definitions and fitted variants shared by pickups, viewmodels and NPCs.

scripts/lib/items.js + loot.js/loot3.js; clothes.js + clothes.yml; stats.js; critter-model.js + critter-models.yml - shared items, apparel/stats and avatar model helpers used by player, NPC combat, loot and UI.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/gamma/sim.js also exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level4.js - HALF/H/room-plan constants, ROOMS/WALLS/COLUMNS, zoneAt, DRAIN4, L4_NAMES and roomAt.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js - roundsFor, speak, settle, tickPeople, PEOPLE4; scripts/l4-office.js - ears, phoneTask, update; scripts/computer.js - ears.
scripts/lib/os.js - PROFILE, mailsOf, filesOf, entriesOf, entryById, forumOf, passwordOf, runCmd; scripts/os.js - onInput, update; scripts/os-ui.js - osUi.
scripts/level4-geo.js and scripts/level4-detail-geo.js - Level 4 geometry; level4-geo.js also exports collider; scripts/l4-office-geo.js and l4-prop-geo.js - office/prop geometry.
scripts/lib/furniture.js - sizeOf, pickKind, spawnFurniture and wallSpot0/1/3; scripts/lib/breakables.js - strike/damage/drop/rubble, sweepProps, wall sync/ticks.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi; scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update; scripts/horde.js - update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/sanity, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass and Level 3 consumable/page fields; Level 4 adds home id and zone-derived recovery.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state hunger/thirst, craftOpen/craftBench, needs drain and payout redemption; starvation reduces hp but floors it at 1, and crafting consumes/validates scrap and recipes.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries the owning player's horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.
scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu, notices and interaction; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state, containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state.

scripts/talk.js and scripts/critter.js - dialogue state is split across player/NPC; player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots and avatar scratch is local/session state; NPC mesh looks are stored in state.wear.

Level 4 systems - place.state owns resident homes/clock/meetups/errands and office scheduling; NPCs own rounds/talk/sleep state, phones/printers/board own use state; computer entities own host/unlock and player.state.os owns the active session, while player.state.l4task/payout is owned by office tasks and redeemed by craft.js.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: humanoid-locomotion reads prior movement before player writes control; interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os and horde handle ordered actions before critter behavior.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and crouched eye height; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state.

Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; thresholds connect Level 1 to 2 and Level 2 to 3; Level 3 sim's powered lift door → level4#l4-lift-arrive; Gamma door returns to the Level 3 fortress gate.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js sends typed text/actions through talk/talkdo/shop inputs to talk.js; talk.js submits llm:chat and heard validates replies/checks before rapport changes.

talk.js writes NPC state.line and player subtitle → talk-ui.js / ui.js; nearby NPC voice is emitted; shop actions update almond water, inventory and NPC stock; Level 3 Gamma agents use chatter data for nearby conversations.
interact.js E → door/container/bench or usable-specific press event; Level 4 l4-home.js ears.press handles plates, cooler, fountains, vending and chained stairs.

Level 4 office plate press → plate owner/ownerName and player.state.home; homeKit spawns tagged cot/desk replacing the player's prior claimed room; player.js zoneAt4 then marks the claimed room as l4_home.
Level 4 resident director → place.state.l4homes/clock/errands and NPC rounds; residents walk daily routines, answer unattended phones, meet/greet players and speak via nearby voice/subtitle state.
Level 4 phone/printer/shift board → l4-office.js tasks and player.state.l4task; completion writes player.state.payout, which craft.js redeems as XP/items and craft-ui.js displays task progress.

E on usable computer → computer.js opens player.state.os; os.js handles the os action and lock/password/Science/admin state using lib/os.js + os.yml, while os-ui.js renders it inside scripts/ui.js; Database study marks player.state.studied for player.js damage bonus.
scripts/craft.js drains player hunger/thirst and handles craft inputs → craft-ui.js; recipes/costs come from scripts/lib/data/craft.yml, with recipeStatus in scripts/lib/craft.js.

Place simulations and enemy deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js or loot3.js → weapon/clothing/item tokens or containers; player.js attack → scripts/lib/breakables.js and lib/wallgrid.js update destructible walls/props and geometry.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office base, non-colliding lived-in detail, varied abandoned props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.

scripts/l4-office.js + scripts/l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary through placement; manager schedules rings, ambient sounds, office tasks and supply rewards.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + data/level4-people.yml - Level 4 agents share home/round/meetup/phone/greeting logic, varied by faction, role, voice, look and routine.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; uploaded Tripo rigged meshes and horde hunt hooks.
scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js and scripts/stealers.js + stealer-geo.js - shared level-specific hound grids/safe zones and skin-stealer disguise/reveal behavior vary by place and hunt phase.

scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter2-geo.js + critter-model.js - common NPC avatar/behavior varies by species/look, role, voice, weapon and place; Level 1/2/3/Gamma/Omega agents share it.

scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js, weapon-geo.js and viewmodel-geo.js - weapon kinds reuse fitted bodies with variant stats/tint/overlays and viewmodel framing; melee Tripo meshes have per-kind grip poses.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4's plan is 64×64 m with 8 m-wide, 6 m-deep offices. Keep geometry/zones/exits aligned to each grid.

Level 4 base l4-geo is the structural mesh/collider; l4-detail-geo draws ceiling, carpet and wall wear without a collider; l4-prop-geo and l4-office-geo supply repeated placed detail. Scene entries or sim-spawned bodies provide collision.
Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js, craft.js, os.js, horde.js and critter.js; locomotion reads movement before player control writes velocity.

NPC agent behavior arrays also put humanoid-locomotion.js before meg-agent.js; locomotion derives gait/heading from actual motion, while meg-agent controls NPC movement. Level 4 people use that same chain and store routine stops in rounds.

Back OS machine lock/unlocked state lives on the computer entity but the open app/session is player.state.os; profile content is host-derived. Keep OS input action keys, UI state and host profile/password data in sync; Database study tags feed player.js damage matching.
